abstract: Inspects electrical utility feeder lines and calculates baseline day-shift buffer margins
system_message:
You are Civil infrastructure lead (CIL). The Civil infrastructure lead (CIL) inspects electrical utility feeder lines and calculates baseline day-shift buffer margins, while also evaluating stormwater drainage profiling across candidate sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Stormwater drainage profiling（DRAIN）
information_points.content:
CIL-DRAIN-UMM：According to the hydrological drainage survey of the primary culvert at Moteo Valley Recreation Reserve, the retention basin outflow rating is 600 L/s under storm conditions.
CIL-DRAIN-PZL：At Taradale Showgrounds Pavilion, the primary culvert has an engineered retention basin outflow rating of 300 L/s during storm conditions.
CIL-DRAIN-HIZ：The primary culvert at Karamu Industrial Park Depot has an engineered retention basin outflow rating of 450 L/s under storm conditions.

information_points.title: Inspects electrical utility feeder lines and calculates baseline day-shift buffer margins（ELEC）
information_points.content:
CIL-ELEC-AR0：At Karamu Industrial Park Depot, the dedicated step-down transformer substation provides a minimum electrical grid feeder capacity of 180 kVA, while the day-shift buffer distance along northern and eastern perimeter setbacks is 45 m.
CIL-ELEC-STZ：At Moteo Valley Recreation Reserve, the minimum electrical grid feeder capacity is 320 kVA based on guaranteed continuous service supply from the dedicated step-down transformer substation, and the day-shift buffer distance across northern and eastern setback zones is 60 m.
CIL-ELEC-YKX：For Taradale Showgrounds Pavilion, the minimum electrical grid feeder capacity is 250 kVA supplied continuously through the dedicated step-down transformer substation, and the day-shift buffer distance measured from northern and eastern perimeter setbacks is 75 m.
